description: This file declares the WindowManagerHandler class and its nested Notification class, which manage window-related events and interactions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for initialization, termination, event handling, and rendering control, as well as interface implementations for window notifications.

classes.name: WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class implementing the IRDKWindowManager::INotification interface to handle window-related notifications such as user inactivity, disconnection, and readiness events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates the window manager.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON events related to window management.

methods.name: renderReady
methods.description: Checks if a specific application instance is ready for rendering.

methods.name: enableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables display rendering for a specific application instance.
